messages:
maria: Observed a spike in cell-ordering errors on an INT8/AWQ candidate during our CSV->table extraction suite.

oliver: repro steps?

maria: run `./evals/table-extract --model=open-llama-awq-int8 --dataset=invoice-rows --seed=42`
maria: diff shows column headers shifting right after row 64, duplicated key names, and some numeric cells becoming 'N/A'.

vikram: any correlation with sequence length or long customer notes?

maria: yes — only when the prompt prefix > ~512 tokens and contains table-like separators.

sasha: sounds like a KV-cache boundary or attention alignment issue. I saw similar behavior with split pools.

liz: can you dump token logits around the failure boundary? need token-level probs to see collapse.

maria: attaching a short log excerpt:
```
# log snippet
step 64: input_len=514 kv_cache_util=0.79
token 10234 -> 502 (prob 0.82 -> 0.03)
# followed by repeated header tokens and column shift
```

quant-bot: Canary run queued: canary-1779991234-int8-crossprofile (tags: fast-eval, table-extract)

oliver: quick experiment — try disabling prefix cache in runtime config: `REDWOOD_PREFIX_CACHE=false` and re-run the canary.

maria: did that. initial canary shows reduced shifts but still ~1.2% accuracy regression vs fp16 on the table-schema metric.

vikram: hypothesis: AWQ per-tensor rescale for attention keys isn't preserving alignment for long prefixes. Try AWQ with per-channel rescale on keys+values.

sasha: also run the GPTQ candidate (same baseline) to see if this is quantization-algo specific.

liz: assigning bisect to @vikram and @maria — please create a minimized repro and bisect quant-config diffs to find the regression commit.

maria: created branch `git/quant/bisect/1779991234`, trimmed dataset to 200 examples that trigger the failure, run id `1779992000`.

oliver: if bisect indicates kernel-level regression, be ready to temporarily disable fused-kv-pack on canary nodes.

maria: latest canary logs: occasional token collapse still occurs when the prefix contains table markers ("|" or "\t").

sasha: that tokenization hint is useful — maybe token->byte offset alignment interacts poorly with quant buckets. Add instrumentation for token->byte offsets and quant-scale at each layer.

maria: adding instrumentation now — will upload dumps to `s3://redwood-canary/1779991234/kv-dump.json` when done.

quant-bot: Canary finished: 6 runs. Summary: GPTQ-mix-8 shows no regression, AWQ-int8 candidates still +0.9% error vs fp16 (best).

vikram: next steps (48h): 1) reproduce on dedicated GPU (no shared-pool), 2) test AWQ with per-channel-rescale + disable fused-kv-pack, 3) collect token offset traces and quant scales.

liz: scheduled a 10am PT sync tomorrow to triage results. If we confirm a regress, file a short blameless note and include canary ids.

maria: noted and thanks everyone :pray:
